description: Plan Marshall is a Claude Code marketplace and orchestration layer for AI coding assistants that enforces phase-driven planning workflows. It ships ten production bundles of skills, agents, and commands covering core orchestration, Java/JavaScript/Python/OCI/documentation/requirements/plugin-development domains.
description_reasoning: source: README.md introduction (What is it section)

default.description: Root project module housing the pyprojectx-based test harness for the entire marketplace. Contains the unified pytest suite that exercises every bundle's scripts (plan-marshall, pm-dev-*, pm-documents, pm-plugin-development, pm-requirements) plus the multi-target adapter generator.

documentation.description: The repository's prose documentation tree. Carries the architectural decision records (doc/adr), the concept narratives that explain how the system works (doc/concepts), the contributor-facing build and layout guides (doc/developer), the operator-facing usage guides (doc/user), and the standalone cloud-lane plan corpus (doc/plans).

plan-marshall.description: Core orchestration bundle providing the complete 5-phase development workflow (init, refine, outline, plan, execute, finalize), task planning, git/PR workflows, Sonar integration, and build automation across Maven/Gradle/npm/pyproject. Hosts foundational infrastructure (script executor, manage-config, manage-architecture, manage-lessons, permissions, logging) that every other bundle consumes.

pm-dev-frontend.description: General frontend development standards bundle providing vanilla JavaScript (ES2022+) and CSS knowledge skills, JSDoc analyzer, ESLint flat-config standards, Jest testing patterns, and the JS/CSS triage extension. TypeScript and frameworks (React/Vue/Angular) are out of scope.

pm-dev-frontend-cui.description: CUI-specific JavaScript project standards complementing pm-dev-frontend with opinionated patterns for Maven+npm dual-build CUI projects: frontend-maven-plugin integration, Quarkus DevUI / NiFi project layouts, and SonarQube configuration for JS.

pm-dev-java.description: Comprehensive Java development knowledge base covering core patterns, null safety (JSpecify), Lombok, CDI/Quarkus, JUnit 5 unit & integration testing, JavaDoc, maintenance prioritization, Maven profile classification, and the Java triage extension.

pm-dev-java-cui.description: CUI-specific Java standards bundle layering on pm-dev-java: CuiLogger + LogRecord structured-logging patterns, CUI test library + value-object contracts, HttpHandler/HttpResult HTTP client, MockWebServer testing, and the cui-logging enforcement recipe.

pm-dev-oci.description: OCI container expertise bundle covering image building (minimal bases, multi-stage, pinned versions), multi-platform builds, distroless health probes, runtime hardening, vulnerability scanning, supply-chain security (signing, SBOMs), and OWASP Docker Top 10 controls.

pm-dev-python.description: Python 3.10+ development standards bundle covering core language patterns (types, dataclasses, pathlib, async), pytest testing with isolation/fixtures/coverage, ruff+mypy toolchain integration, and the Python triage extension.

pm-documents.description: Documentation domain bundle providing AsciiDoc formatting/validation/link-verification workflows, content-quality review standards, ADR and Interface specification management, narrative-style references, and PlantUML/SVG diagram authoring + verification recipes.

pm-plugin-development.description: Plugin development toolchain for the marketplace itself: create new components (agents/skills/commands/bundles), diagnose quality issues (plugin-doctor), scan marketplace inventory, apply lessons learned, and orchestrate verification-feedback workflows under phase-6-finalize.

pm-requirements.description: Requirements engineering bundle covering SMART requirements authoring, specification structure, project setup, planning documentation, bidirectional traceability between requirements/specs/code, and the requirements triage extension.
